subject: The wardroom of the colony ship ariadne at supper, one table and one pot. The hydroponics bay has its first crop up, forty racks of it, and every rack needs a label. Mac has been writing strain codes on them. Hamond has been writing over the codes, in letters twice the size, with the names of relatives. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
card: soc.names, version yurbin+waititi (js/content-social-alt.js; tests and effects in js/content-social.js)
notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Names on the Racks). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
